terms_body: By using this app, you agree to provide accurate information and to use the platform only for donating and requesting blood. The platform is committed to protecting your personal data and not sharing it except when necessary. The app administration reserves the right to modify services or suspend accounts that violate the terms. By creating an account, you agree to these terms and conditions.
role_switch_warning: When you submit a request for blood, the "I am a donor" status will be automatically cancelled and you will not appear in the active donors list. You can reactivate it later after your request ends.

about_app_paragraph_1: The blood donation platform is a digital app that aims to facilitate communication between blood donors and patients in need. The platform provides a fast and safe way to find suitable donors, publish donation requests, and manage appointments and notifications related to donation operations.
about_app_paragraph_2: The platform seeks to promote a culture of blood donation and contribute to saving lives by providing an easy-to-use environment that helps respond quickly to cases that need blood. It also enables users to track their donation history and manage their personal data with ease.
about_app_paragraph_3: Every blood donation is a new chance at life, and together we can make a real difference in our community.
developer_contact_description: For any inquiry, suggestion, or to report a problem, you can contact us and we will be happy to help you as soon as possible.

donor_card_explanation: The donor card is your interactive profile within the platform, showing your giving level, donation count, points earned, and achievements throughout your humanitarian journey. Earn points through donation, commitment, and participation, and rise through five levels that reflect your impact on the community.

quran_verse: وَمَنْ أَحْيَاهَا فَكَأَنَّمَا أَحْيَا النَّاسَ جَمِيعًا
hadith_relief: «مَنْ نَفَّسَ عَنْ مُؤْمِنٍ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ الدُّنْيَا، نَفَّسَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَمَنْ يَسَّرَ عَلَى مُعْسِرٍ، يَسَّرَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، وَمَنْ سَتَرَ مُسْلِمًا، سَتَرَهُ اللَّهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، وَاللَّهُ فِي عَوْنِ الْعَبْدِ مَا كَانَ الْعَبْدُ فِي عَوْنِ أَخِيهِ»
quran_saving_life: مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَٰلِكَ كَتَبْنَا عَلَىٰ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَنَّهُ مَنْ قَتَلَ نَفْسًا بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ أَوْ فَسَادٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَتَلَ النَّاسَ جَمِيعًا وَمَنْ أَحْيَاهَا فَكَأَنَّمَا أَحْيَا النَّاسَ جَمِيعًا
